description: We are BRAINSTROMERS, a multidisciplinary team passionate about space exploration, engineering, AI, and innovation. Our focus is astronaut training and developing interactive solutions to address the challenges of human spaceflight. We value creativity, scientific thinking, and hands-on problem-solving. We are looking for motivated teammates skilled in programming, AI/ML, physics, data analysis, simulation, hardware, UI/UX, and scientific research.
summary:
Living on the Moon has always been one of humanity's biggest dreams. But what would it take to make it possible?
JUNIOR ASTRONAUT TRAINER is a 3D lunar exploration and survival game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Players experience a seven-day lunar mission, travelling from Earth to a lunar base where they must manage life-support systems, conserve resources, monitor crew health, conduct experiments, and explore the lunar surface using a research rover.

The project addresses the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by transforming concepts of astronaut training and lunar survival into interactive gameplay. Players learn about oxygen management, water conservation, energy systems, lunar conditions, and the challenges of maintaining a habitable environment.

JUNIOR ASTRONAUT TRAINER aims to make space science more accessible and engaging by allowing players to learn through exploration, experimentation, and decision-making. It connects scientific knowledge with practical challenges, helping players understand what it takes to sustain human life beyond Earth.
details:
JUNIOR ASTRONAUT MISSION TRAINER is a 3D lunar exploration and survival game that simulates the challenges of living on the Moon. Players take the role of an astronaut on a seven-day mission, managing a lunar base, monitoring crew health, conserving oxygen, water and food, and exploring the lunar surface using a research rover.

The game turns real space science into interactive challenges. Players experience the importance of life-support systems, energy management, lunar environmental conditions, and mission planning through decisions that affect their survival.

Built using JavaScript, React, Three.js, Zustand, and Blender, ASTROPHAGE combines 3D exploration, cinematic storytelling, and educational gameplay in a browser-based experience.

Our goal is to make lunar science engaging and accessible while helping players understand the engineering and teamwork required to sustain human life beyond Earth.
